experiment_name: Stage 1 automated discovery with independent MQTT observation
notes: run_summary.csv was regenerated post-hoc (no hardware re-run) to fix a bug in the orchestrator's convergence-detection: for 7/10 runs the LLM found the initial reading already within tolerance and saved a skill with zero set_pwm calls, so agent_loop.py's trail (which only records a row once set_pwm has been issued) was empty; the original code treated an empty trail as not_converged with blank final_control_reading/final_absolute_error. The corrected values were recovered from each run's saved_skill.json (final_error = target - reading, per agent_loop.py's own save_skill contract), not fabricated. time_to_convergence_s is left null for those 7 rows because discovery_start/discovery_end timestamps were not persisted and could not be reconstructed post-hoc. Raw discovery_runs.csv and mqtt_sensor_timeseries.csv were collected on real hardware and are untouched.
